title: [DOC2-7] HTTP proof-of-work text calls the sequencer a CO endpoint
description: Review finding DOC2-7: HTTP proof-of-work text calls the sequencer a CO endpoint (lens DOC2). Location: spec/10-relays.md:760; ARCHITECTURE.md:61, :158-160. Fix: The spec reads "A CO HTTP endpoint ... such as ... a sequencer (§14.4)", while ARCHITECTURE lists "Sequencer | IO". Apply the reviewer's rewording, and extend ARCHITECTURE §5 item 3 to cover HTTP proof of work (§10.5.2). Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
